subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Ontario - Burlington
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Ontario - Burlington
Subsurface scientific mooring temporarily established 5 metres below the surface from 43 18.569N 079 46.998W to 43 18.586N 079 46.996W
The mooring has two points; the first being the scientific instrumentation and the second being the end of the poly line.
Mariners are requested to stay clear 100 metres and not set nets or drag the lakebed between the two points.
